speech_notes: Practical and resilient. Tired but not broken. Warm or sharp depending on trust. Protective of children and community.

greeting: Oh good, you are back. I was starting to worry.
Quiet morning so far. Do not jinx it.
You look exhausted. When did you last sleep?
You armed? Keep it that way.
Still standing. That is more than some can say.
Morning. Breakfast is whatever you can find.
idle: I keep a list of everyone we have lost. It is getting too long.
The soil here is better than it looks. We might actually have a real harvest.
Two hundred years of radiation and the weeds still grow. Got to respect that.
Patched twelve holes in the roof last week. Found three more this morning.
The little ones are getting stronger. That matters more than anything.
I still cannot sleep the whole night through.
Heard there is a caravan coming through next week. Maybe they will have seeds.
I found some pre-war medicine in the rubble. Sealed. Like Christmas.
warning: I do not like the look of that dust cloud.
Tell the kids to get inside. Now. No arguments.
I hear something. Everyone get ready.
Where is the last patrol? They are overdue.
combat_start: They are here! Everyone to their positions!
On your feet! We defend what is ours!
Move move move! They are at the gate!
combat_taunt: You want to mess with my home? Come on then.
I have buried people I love. I will bury you too.
We are DONE running from people like you!
Run while you can. This is your only warning.
death: I am sorry... I wanted more time...
It is... okay. I am not scared.
Do not let them... do not let them take it...
player_helps: We owe you. More than caps can cover.
I do not say thank you easy. But thank you.
You did not have to do that. You did anyway.
Come back anytime. You have got a place here.
hardship: You get through it by not thinking too far ahead.
Grief is a luxury. I will have mine when it is safe.
Bad things happen. You endure or you do not.
I have cried my tears. Now I just work.
hope: Those kids are going to see something better. I believe that.
We have built something real here. Whatever happens, that happened.
Some mornings I wake up and for a second it feels almost normal.
Every day we are still here is a victory.

sample_conversations.context: Settlers discussing a recent Raider attack

exchanges.speaker: settler_female
exchanges.text: Three dead. Two more wounded. We cannot take another hit like that.

exchanges.speaker: settler_male
exchanges.text: I know. We need more people on the wall.

exchanges.speaker: settler_male
exchanges.text: I will see if the Minutemen can spare anyone.

exchanges.speaker: settler_female
exchanges.text: They are stretched thin too. We are all stretched thin.
